notes.title: Demo from the Kickstarter is available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We have released the original Kickstarter demo on Steam. Please note that it's very much a minimum viable product, but does show the general flow of the game we are creating. 

We have been hard at work trying to prepare the Steam side of Card TD for it's eventual release into Early Access. In short news, we have chosen to release the game in Early Access, as life has gotten away from us and progress has been slower than we originally anticipated. 

We are actively continuing development, but it is slow, and since this game represents a unique genre mix of tower defense and deck building, we want to be able to provide the community with the opportunity to voice their inputs. 

The current state of the game, versus the Demo is pretty different and will be frequently updated as we add new content in the form of maps, features, character selections, themed worlds and more, so if you like the demo, please consider purchasing our game, or at least adding it to your Wishlist for tracking of our progress. 

Stay tuned for the release of Card TD to Early Access soon! 

Thank you all!
